about: The towns' flow and low-point maps (Art/Levels/area_erosion_maps.py), from the finished heights (erosion included). 16-bit grey PNGs, north up: row 0 is the window's north edge (X covers[1][0]), column 0 its west edge (Y covers[0][1]); each pixel one height-raster cell (cell, cm). flow: round(65535 x clip((log10 A + 2) / 8, 0, 1)), A the m2 draining through the cell (a priority flood's drainage over the window and 30 m round it); lows: millimeters of standing water before the hollow spills. Puddles: lows over 10 (1 cm) where flow is high (the Towns plan, section 6). covers: [[X0, Y0], [X1, Y1]] cm; size [columns, rows].
